caption:
No good deed is too small to count

Allah says every person will be shown their deeds, even an atom's weight of good. Do one small good thing tonight and trust that you will see it.

Surah Az-Zalzala 99:6-8

Pick one small good deed before you sleep tonight.

#smalldeeds #gooddeeds #surahzalzalah #quranreels

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
